author: Bobby Grayson
description: Remaining fidelity gaps are semantic, not syntactic: crash-on-unhandled-cast, real time, selective receive beyond call/reply, non-identity init, multi-node. All are recorded in the README.
title: Five translated examples cover the everyday BEAM toolbox: cast, call, reply, spawn/spawn_link, link, monitor, trap_exit, exit, Process.exit, send_after/timeouts. Each proof follows the frame+terminate recipe; the per-example novelty is one lemma
